title: Tyler1 LCS Promo
tagline: Teaming up with League's biggest influencer to bring fans back to the LCS after the pandemic.

body: The 2022 Spring Finals at NRG Stadium in Houston was the LCS's first in-person show in two years. The league needed more than a good event — it needed a reason for fans to come back, fill a stadium and tune in, and a return that felt worth the wait.

As Creative Director for Riot Games Esports, I pitched and led a campaign that made Tyler1 the face of the Spring Finals — overseeing writers, influencer management, internal and external artists, the RFP process, and the stage, lighting and pyro teams that carried the idea from the promo all the way onto the stage.

Tyler1 is arguably the biggest personality in gaming, which made him the perfect partner to bring fans back. He brought the same energy to the promotional film and live on stage, turning the Finals into a must-see moment that fans couldn't ignore.
led: Pitched and led the Tyler1 influencer campaign
Managed writers, talent and production RFPs
Carried the campaign onto the stage, lighting and pyro

impact.note: The promotional film drove the highest AMA viewership for an LCS Opening Ceremony in the league's history, with positive reactions from fans and stakeholders alike.
